class.name: SeatedHandsSolver
class.brief_description: Rests a seated character's palms on its thighs and lays its fingers along them.
class.description: Holds a body's measured thighs (a profile of the skin's distance round each thigh bone) and palms, set by [method set_thigh] and [method set_palm], and reads a character's animated skeleton ([method set_skeleton], [method set_bone]). [method solve] finds the hand's target on its thigh and the weight its gap asks for; [method search_fingers], [method ease_fingers] and [method lay_fingers] turn each finger joint about the knuckle line so the next joint sits its pad's thickness off the thigh. Side 0 is the left, 1 the right.

method.name: carry
method.description: Takes a point at the side's thigh bone's (or with [param hand], hand bone's) skinned rest to where the animated skeleton's pose has it.

method.name: clear_fingers
method.description: Forgets the side's searched and shown finger turns: the next search is shown at once.

method.name: clip
method.description: The animated hand in its thigh's rest frame.

method.name: ease_fingers
method.description: Moves each shown finger turn [param share] of the way to its searched one, by at most [param limit] radians. The first search after a clear is shown at once.

method.name: gap
method.description: How far [param point], in the thigh's rest frame, is outside the side's thigh profile; negative inside.

method.name: get_finger_angles
method.description: The side's last searched finger turns, three a finger, knuckle to tip.

method.name: get_finger_shown
method.description: The side's finger turns as laid, eased toward the searched ones.

method.name: get_hand
method.description: The last solve's resting hand bone, in the skinned skeleton's space.

method.name: get_ik_target
method.description: The last solve's hand target in the animated skeleton's hand bone's frame; the same as [method get_hand] after [method solve_carried] or [method reapply_carried].

method.name: get_move
method.description: The last solve's correction, a rigid move in the thigh's rest frame, for [method reapply_carried] or [method solve] without [code]full[/code].

method.name: get_outward
method.description: The thigh's outward where the last full solve's wrist landed: the next solve's warm start.

method.name: get_palm_gap
method.description: The animated palm point's gap to the thigh's skin.

method.name: get_roll
method.description: The animated palm's roll against the thigh, radians; 0 after a reapply.

method.name: get_tilt
method.description: The animated hand's tilt off the thigh, radians; 0 after a reapply.

method.name: get_weight
method.description: The weight the last solve's palm gap asks for: 1 within [code]contact_full[/code], 0 past [code]contact_none[/code], and 0 for a hand pointing back up its thigh.

method.name: has_finger_angles
method.description: Whether the side's fingers have been searched since they were last cleared.

method.name: has_fingers
method.description: Whether [method set_finger_bones] gave the side's hand.

method.name: lay_fingers
method.description: Turns each of the side's finger joints by its shown turn times [param weight] on its current local rotation; returns the summed turn, radians.

method.name: reapply_carried
method.description: An earlier solve's [param move] carried on the given pose: the weight and gap read afresh.

method.name: search_fingers
method.description: Searches each finger joint's turn from the skeleton's pose as it stands. Reads only; [method lay_fingers] writes.

method.name: set_bone
method.description: The side's thigh (or with [param hand], hand) bone: its index on the animated skeleton, the turn from that skeleton's rest to the skinned one's, the skinned rest, and the turn back.

method.name: set_finger_angles
method.description: Sets the side's searched finger turns, as if searched.

method.name: set_finger_bones
method.description: The side's hand and the middle, index and little fingers' first joints on the animated skeleton, and each resting finger's three joints, knuckle to tip.

method.name: set_palm
method.description: The side's palm at rest, in the skinned skeleton's space: its wrist and middle knuckle, the normal it faces, the point that rests, the contact points none of which may sink, and the fingers' pad thickness.

method.name: set_skeleton
method.description: The animated skeleton the bones are read from and the fingers laid on.

method.name: set_thigh
method.description: The side's thigh at rest: its axis from the hip joint to the knee, its front, and the skin's distance from the axis per cell, section-major.

method.name: set_tuning
method.description: Sets any of the solver's tuning by name: [code]sections[/code], [code]sectors[/code], [code]profile_from[/code], [code]profile_to[/code], [code]contact_full[/code], [code]contact_none[/code], [code]max_side_angle[/code], [code]max_palm_roll[/code], [code]palm_clearance[/code], [code]resolve_passes[/code], [code]converged[/code], [code]max_extend[/code], [code]max_flex[/code], [code]max_drape[/code], [code]relaxed_bend[/code], [code]tip_share[/code], [code]newton_steps[/code], [code]contact_tolerance[/code].

method.name: solve
method.description: Solves the side's hand from the animated skeleton's pose: with [param full], [method solve_carried] from [param warm]; without, [method reapply_carried] with [param move]. [method get_ik_target] is then in the animated skeleton's hand bone's frame.

method.name: solve_carried
method.description: Finds the side's resting hand: the rigid move, in the thigh's rest frame, that lays the hand flat against the thigh where its wrist lands and puts its palm on the skin. [param thigh_carry] and [param hand_carry] take a point at rest to where the pose has it; [param warm], an earlier solve's [method get_outward], or zero.
